sloka: अवाप्तं धर्मचरणं यशश्च विपुलं त्वया ।रामं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया ।। ६.१२२.३३ ।।
transliteration: avāptaṁ dharmacaraṇaṁ yaśaśca vipulaṁ tvayā ।rāmaṁ śuśrūṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā ।। 6.122.33 ।।

translations.english: "Videha's Sita, you have also earned fame by serving Rama with devotion and following the righteous path."
